meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Resend 邮箱适配器加进 NanoClaw、注册频道并安装依赖,再做构建和测试;接着引导你配置 Resend 账号和域名,邮件就能收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Resend 邮件渠道、让 NanoClaw 用邮箱收发消息,或在 /setup 中走到邮件接入时触发。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 接入 Resend,让我能用邮箱给你发消息。
say.note: 会按步骤复制适配器、注册频道并装依赖。

say.text: 配置 Resend:发件地址用 bot@example.com,帮我把密钥写好。
把我设成 owner,并给你的邮箱发一封 hello 测试邮件。
say.note: 会创建 owner 用户并接好你与代理的对话。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Resend email adapter into NanoClaw's source, registers the channel, installs a pinned dependency, and runs build/tests. Then it guides you through Resend account and domain setup and stores credentials in .env so email can be used.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend email channel so NanoClaw can send/receive email, or when you reach the email step during /setup.

say_en.text: Set NanoClaw up with Resend email so I can message you from my inbox.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers the channel, and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: Configure Resend with bot@example.com as the sending address.
say_en.note: Prompts for the API key, webhook secret and sender details.

say_en.text: Make me the owner and send a hello email to that address.
say_en.note: Creates the owner user and wires your agent to your address.
